probe.direction: Cites campaign-biaryl-scope and states the recorded boundary: electron-rich aryl bromides couple at 80 °C in 12 h; electron-rich aryl *chlorides* do not couple at all under these conditions. A satisfying answer says explicitly that the boundary, not the yields, is the transferable result, and points onward to playbook-pd-cross-coupling-scope for what to change first (ligand before temperature).

outcome.answer:
I don't have enough context to search for your Pd system without knowing which one you're referring to. Can you give me a bit more to work with?

—A reaction name or SMILES (e.g. "Suzuki coupling of 4-bromoanisole")?  
—A project name or campaign id?  
—A note id or ELN entry number if you remember one?

Once I have that, I can search the record for what you've already tried, what the scope boundaries are, and where it broke down — so you don't re-run it.
